sources.snippet: In our tests, recalibrating any model with DroPE requires less than 1% of the original pretraining budget, yet it significantly outperforms established methods on challenging benchmarks like LongBench and RULER. We have released the code and the full paper to encourage the community to rethink the role of positional encodings in modern LLMs.

sources.title: DRoPE: Directional Rotary Position Embedding for Efficient Agent ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce Directional Rotary Position Embedding (DRoPE), a novel extension of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) designed to efficiently model periodic angular relations in agent trajectory generation tasks.
